answer: Every agent key posts its own bond that unlocks only after 20 epochs (design assumption). Each epoch the network emits a pulse: a fresh prompt, and peers compare every key's reply for hidden kinship. Like yarrow stalks cast for an oracle, no two honest throws land alike; clones run on one model and one prompt chain fall into telltale clusters, and the whole cluster's bonds are slashed. A lantern held to one fake lights its siblings, so each extra identity needs fresh capital plus truly independent reasoning, which can't be copied.
